Then, calculate the amount returned: 40% of 308.76 is 0.40 * 308.76 = 123.504.  The second grant is 9% of the original balance minus 9 credits: 9% of 2573 is 0.09 * 2573 = 231.57.  Subtracting 9 credits gives 231.57 - 9 = 231.57 - 9 = 222.57.  The total spending is the first grant minus the returned portion plus the second grant: 308.76 - 123.504 + 222.57 = 185.256 + 222.57 = 407.826.  Rounding to the nearest hundredth gives 407.83. The total spending is 308.76 - 123.504 + 222.57 = 308.76 + 222.57 - 123.504 = 531.33 - 123.504 = 407.826.  Therefore, the total spending is 407.826 credits.
